authorization: User approved offline design of a separately predefined actually-active constraint condition, retaining unloaded A2mm benchmark and all negative results; subsequent user asked to continue full-flow supervision.
scope: Offline engineering design only; no firmware, serial commands, resets, flashing, load addition or physical motion authorized by this protocol.
limitUnits: ESC command counts, not calibrated amperes or torque
selectionRule: Do not select by candidate performance. Preserve every predefined condition and mirror. Prefer least reduction meeting separately verified actual activation and unchanged safety/task completion. If none qualified, declare no admitted active-amplitude condition; do not keep lowering limits or change load/stroke without a separate plan.
activationMeaning: Near-limit commands are exposure diagnostics, not proof of clipping. Actual amplitude intervention requires requested/pre-clip and final command evidence or direct per-step clipping counter. CA mask bit1 means the NN increment300-count cap, NOT hard actuator saturation; diagnostic reason bit2 is hard clipping. Projection/rate/sector events must be reported separately, not relabelled amplitude saturation.
offlineExposureMeaning: Compare recorded attempted commands with hypothetical limits only to plan qualification. This is not a closed-loop lower-limit simulation, a feasibility or hardware safety proof.

assumedModelScreen.purpose: Baseline task feasibility and constraint-activity diagnostics; no new candidate benefit selection; models are not identified hardware.

paperMetrics: Whole phase2..5 while drive-permitted: mean-position tracking RMSE and L-R synchronization RMS in mm. Report tracking cost, failures and all individual runs. No fabricated task tolerance; firmware guards are not paper accuracy requirements.
nextAdmission: Only a diagnostic baseline may be prepared after source/host checks, with separate Keil/timing validation and fresh drive-OFF confirmation before flash and drive-ON/onsite confirmation before a single small motion. Physical qualification must precede candidate development or formal paired collection.
